name: Barrett M95
tagline: A bullpup .50 BMG anti-materiel rifle that punches through five targets.
summary: The Barrett M95 is a bullpup, bolt-action anti-materiel sniper rifle fed with 5 rounds of .50 BMG. It deals more damage than the AWP, kills humans instantly anywhere but the legs and penetrates up to five objects, but it is heavy, holds only 5 rounds, fires slowly and has the longest reload (4 seconds) of any bolt-action sniper in CSO. Christmas, Enhanced and White Tiger (Transcendent) editions exist.
description: The wiki describes the Barrett M95 (Model 1995) as a bullpup-style, bolt-action, anti-materiel sniper rifle fed with 5 rounds of .50 BMG per magazine. It excels against vehicles and armored units in Human Scenario (three body shots or one unarmored neck shot kill a Titan) and can penetrate up to 5 objects such as walls, humans and zombies. Damage by range (no armor / with armor): head 433/456 at 0m, 418/440 at 36m, 391/412 at 86m; chest & arm 108/114, 104/110, 97/103; gut 135/142, 130/137, 122/128; legs 85 at all ranges. Against zombies with the Part System: head & chest 1,000 per round, gut 250, leg 200; 5 rounds deal 2,000-13,000 to Zombie Scenario bosses at maximum attack power. It costs $5,000 (ammo $12,000 per purchase in Scenario), weighs about 5% more than the AWP, has twice the AWP's recoil and reloads in 4.0 seconds; with Weapon Enhancement it can hold up to 10 rounds. David Black appears with the Christmas Edition in promotional posters.
